pages.title: A Friend in a Shell
pages.text: Raise a Scuttler into a tamed Shellback and mount it.

pages.title: A Friend in a Shell
pages.text: Jelly supplies continued Scuttler care and lamps furnish a lit marine stop for the mount.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Scuttler likes Jellyfish Jelly. Use native maturation/taming without guessed ages or feeding counts. The resulting owned mount must actually accept its rider.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Raise a Scuttler and use the native taming route for its Shellback stage. The installed advancement explicitly describes a raised, tamed mount.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer Jellyfish Jelly to a Scuttler. Its native tooltip identifies this as a favorite food.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Feed Jellyfish Jelly to a Scuttler while raising it toward a Shellback mount. Native food text and taming advancement support the care/maturation branch without supplying an exact maturity threshold.
